name: paulwerner-net
description: Static build for the paulwerner.net landing and legal pages

scripts.verify:no-third-party: grep -rEn "googleapis|gstatic|cdn\.tailwindcss|jsdelivr|unpkg|cdnjs" site/ ghost-theme/ --include='*.html' --include='*.css' --include='*.hbs'; test $? -eq 1 && echo 'PASS: no third-party references in served HTML/CSS/hbs' || { echo 'FAIL: third-party references found (or grep error)'; exit 1; }
